verdicts.title: A $2n^2-log(n)-1$ lower bound for the border rank of matrix multiplication
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: Let M_n denote the matrix multiplication tensor for nxn matrices. We use the border substitution method combined with Koszul flattenings to prove the border rank lower bound of 2n^2-log(n)-1 for M_n.
verdicts.judge_reasoning: The abstract concerns border rank lower bounds for the matrix multiplication tensor M_n via Koszul flattenings, not communication complexity of DISJ_n or any link between border rank and randomized communication complexity.
